name: EAW Australian National Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: EAW crowned its first, and in the surviving record only, Australian National Heavyweight Champion at its own Mayhem supercard on 1 May 2008: John "Mad Dog" Murphy, winning a Four Corners 30 Minute Iron Man Match over Matt Carter, Santino Romano and Bryan Willett. He carried the belt into EAW's own first Lights Out Cage Match two months later, a title defense in all but name against Willett that ended in a double ten-count draw after Dollar's own interference — the last the surviving record shows of the championship or its own champion.
